description: Drafts an online form for an Israeli business, class, school or clinic (signup, health declaration, new employee or client details, parents' permission) from a description: Israeli field types (ID number with checksum, phone, address from the official street lists, bank and branch from the Bank of Israel list, signature, file), questions shown only after a given answer (show_if), a colour, and closing after N answers. Returns a link that opens the nayeret builder with the draft loaded; the owner reviews, types who receives the answers and publishes in their own browser, where the encryption keys are made. Answers are end-to-end encrypted: neither nayeret nor the assistant can ever read them, and this tool publishes nothing. Use it whenever someone wants a Hebrew form, a Google Forms alternative, or to collect details or signatures from people. Stateless: arguments and results are never stored, logged or shared (nayeret.ai/developers/). Not legal or tax advice.

fields.description: The questions in order (1-60). Leave out to start from the template.

label.description: What the person filling it sees, in the form language (usually Hebrew). For info: the paragraph itself.

options.description: For choice, multi and select: 2-50 options.

required.description: Whether an answer is required (default false). A required field that is hidden by show_if is not required.

show_if.description: Show this field only when ANY of these answers was given (e.g. "details" only after "yes").

equals.description: The answer that shows this field: one of that field's options, or "כן" / "לא" for a checkbox.

field.description: 1-based number of an EARLIER field of type choice, multi, select or checkbox.

type.description: Field type. text/textarea: free text; number; date; choice: one of options; multi: several of options; select: dropdown; checkbox: one consent or yes/no tick (its answer is "כן" or "לא"); signature: drawn signature; file: an upload (image, PDF, Word, up to 5 MB); il_id: Israeli ID number (checksum-validated); phone: Israeli phone; email; bank: bank + branch from the Bank of Israel list + account number; address: locality + street from the official lists + house number; info: a paragraph of explanation, no answer.

intro.description: Optional short explanation shown at the top of the form.

lang.description: Language of the summary text: he (default) or en. Files stay in Hebrew (official forms and Israeli letters).

max_answers.description: Optional: close the form automatically after this many answers (places in a class or on a trip).

template.description: Optional starting template when you give no fields: class (signup for a class or kindergarten), employee (new employee details, without form 101), health (health declaration for an activity, with a "details" question shown only after a yes), client (new client for a tradesperson), trip (parents' permission for a school trip), rsvp (event attendance), contact (leave details for a call back), appointment (request an appointment), job (job application with a CV), feedback (satisfaction survey), volunteer (volunteer signup).

theme.description: Colour of the form page (default green).

name: draft_online_form
title: Draft an encrypted online form (Hebrew)
